mapper.sql: id, instance_id, task_id, flow_code, definition_id, node_code, node_name, node_type, business_type, business_id, business_no, flow_name, title, assignee_type, assignee_id, assignee_name, perform_type, approve_count, approve_finished, task_status, comment, status, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, claim_at, finish_at, duration_ms, deleted, tenant_id, provider_trace_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pmis_flow_his_task WHERE assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY finish_at DESC
SELECT FROM pmis_flow_his_task WHERE assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY finish_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pmis_flow_his_task WHERE assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM pmis_flow_his_task WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY finish_at ASC

SELECT node_code AS "nodeCode", node_name AS "nodeName", AVG(duration_ms) AS "avgDurationMs", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM pmis_flow_his_task WHERE flow_code = #{flowCode} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY node_code, node_name ORDER BY "avgDurationMs" DESC

SELECT node_code AS "nodeCode", MAX(node_name) AS "nodeName", MIN(finish_at) AS "firstFinishAt", COUNT(*) AS "visitCount" FROM pmis_flow_his_task WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 AND node_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY node_code ORDER BY MIN(finish_at) ASC

SELECT DISTINCT assignee_id FROM pmis_flow_his_task WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND task_status = 'COMPLETED' AND assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND assignee_id != '0' AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0

SELECT assignee_id AS "assigneeId", MAX(assignee_name) AS "assigneeName", COUNT(1) AS "completedCount", COALESCE(AVG(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms > 0), 0) AS "avgDurationMs", COALESCE(SUM(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms > 0), 0) AS "totalDurationMs" FROM pmis_flow_his_task WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 AND task_status = 'COMPLETED' AND assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND assignee_id != '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND finish_at >= #{startTime} AND finish_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY assignee_id ORDER BY completedCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
